books_documents.name: Book of Mormon.zip
books_documents.summary: A sacred text of the Latter Day Saint movement, presented as a religious history and testimony concerning ancient peoples in the Americas.

books_documents.name: King James Bible.zip
books_documents.summary: The 1611 English translation of the Christian Bible, containing the Old and New Testaments in its influential King James wording.

books_documents.name: THE CHILDREN'S BIBLE.zip
books_documents.summary: A retelling of selected Bible stories in language intended for younger readers, moving through major figures and events of both testaments.

books_documents.name: The Confessions of St. Augustine.zip
books_documents.summary: Augustine of Hippo's spiritual autobiography and theological reflection on memory, sin, conversion, time, and the search for God.

books_documents.name: The Koran (Al-Qur'an).zip
books_documents.summary: An English rendering of the Qur'an, Islam's central scripture, organized into chapters addressing faith, worship, ethics, law, and prophetic narratives.

books_documents.id: books_documents/the life of buddha and its lessons by henry steel olcott.zip
books_documents.name: The Life of Buddha and Its Lessons by Henry Steel Olcott.zip
books_documents.relativePath: books_documents/The Life of Buddha and Its Lessons by Henry Steel Olcott.zip
books_documents.summary: Henry Steel Olcott's brief account of the Buddha's life and the ethical and philosophical lessons he drew from Buddhist teaching.

books_documents.id: books_documents/the pilgrim's progress by john bunyan.zip
books_documents.name: The Pilgrim's Progress by John Bunyan.zip
books_documents.relativePath: books_documents/The Pilgrim's Progress by John Bunyan.zip
books_documents.summary: A Christian allegory following Christian's difficult journey from the City of Destruction toward the Celestial City and spiritual salvation.

books_documents.name: Apology by Plato.zip
books_documents.summary: Plato's account of Socrates' defense at his trial, exploring his philosophical mission, civic duty, wisdom, and attitude toward death.

books_documents.id: books_documents/as a man thinketh by james allen.zip
books_documents.name: As a man thinketh by James Allen.zip
books_documents.relativePath: books_documents/As a man thinketh by James Allen.zip
books_documents.summary: A short self-help essay arguing that habitual thought shapes character, conduct, circumstances, achievement, and inner peace.

books_documents.id: books_documents/beyond good and evil by nietzsche.zip
books_documents.name: Beyond Good and Evil by Nietzsche.zip
books_documents.relativePath: books_documents/Beyond Good and Evil by Nietzsche.zip
books_documents.summary: Nietzsche's critique of traditional morality and philosophy, examining truth, power, religion, culture, and the assumptions behind moral judgment.

books_documents.id: books_documents/mysticism and logic and other essays by bertrand russell.zip
books_documents.name: Mysticism and Logic and Other Essays by Bertrand Russell.zip
books_documents.relativePath: books_documents/Mysticism and Logic and Other Essays by Bertrand Russell.zip
books_documents.summary: A collection of Bertrand Russell's essays on philosophy, science, mathematics, knowledge, ethics, education, and the tension between mystical and logical thought.

books_documents.id: books_documents/on liberty by john stuart mill.zip
books_documents.name: On Liberty by John Stuart Mill.zip
books_documents.relativePath: books_documents/On Liberty by John Stuart Mill.zip
books_documents.summary: John Stuart Mill's argument for individual freedom of thought and action, limited chiefly by the need to prevent harm to others.

books_documents.name: Pascal's Pensées by Blaise Pascal.zip
books_documents.summary: A posthumous collection of Pascal's fragments on faith, reason, human nature, suffering, diversion, and arguments for Christianity.

books_documents.id: books_documents/politics,a treatise on government by aristotle.zip
books_documents.name: Politics,A Treatise on Government by Aristotle.zip
books_documents.relativePath: books_documents/Politics,A Treatise on Government by Aristotle.zip
books_documents.summary: Aristotle's study of political communities, constitutions, citizenship, justice, education, and the conditions he believed support a flourishing state.

books_documents.id: books_documents/the communist manifesto by karl marx and friedrich engels.zip
books_documents.name: The Communist Manifesto by Karl Marx and Friedrich Engels.zip
books_documents.relativePath: books_documents/The Communist Manifesto by Karl Marx and Friedrich Engels.zip
books_documents.summary: Marx and Engels' political pamphlet interpreting history through class struggle and calling for workers to overturn capitalist social relations.

books_documents.id: books_documents/the critique of pure reason by immanuel kant.zip
books_documents.name: The Critique of Pure Reason by Immanuel Kant.zip
books_documents.relativePath: books_documents/The Critique of Pure Reason by Immanuel Kant.zip
books_documents.summary: Kant's investigation of the scope and limits of human knowledge, asking how experience, reason, space, time, and causality make understanding possible.

books_documents.id: books_documents/the ethics of aristotle by aristotle.zip
books_documents.name: The Ethics of Aristotle by Aristotle.zip
books_documents.relativePath: books_documents/The Ethics of Aristotle by Aristotle.zip
books_documents.summary: Aristotle's account of human flourishing through virtue, practical judgment, friendship, responsible action, and a life shaped by excellent habits.

books_documents.name: The Republic by Plato.zip
books_documents.summary: Plato's dialogue on justice, education, political order, knowledge, and the ideal state, including the allegory of the cave.

books_documents.id: books_documents/the simple life by charles wagner.zip
books_documents.name: The Simple Life by Charles Wagner.zip
books_documents.relativePath: books_documents/The Simple Life by Charles Wagner.zip
books_documents.summary: An essay advocating simplicity in personal conduct, possessions, relationships, and civic life as an answer to needless complexity and social pressure.

books_documents.name: Lincoln's Gettysburg Address.zip
books_documents.summary: Abraham Lincoln's brief 1863 speech honoring the dead at Gettysburg and redefining the Civil War around national unity, equality, and democratic government.

books_documents.name: The Declaration of Independence.zip
books_documents.summary: The 1776 declaration announcing the American colonies' separation from Britain and setting out grievances and principles of natural rights and government.

books_documents.name: The Federalist Papers.zip
books_documents.summary: Eighty-five essays by Hamilton, Madison, and Jay arguing for ratification of the U.S. Constitution and explaining the proposed federal system.

books_documents.id: books_documents/the united states bill of rights.zip
books_documents.name: The United States Bill of Rights.zip
books_documents.relativePath: books_documents/The United States Bill of Rights.zip
books_documents.summary: The first ten amendments to the U.S. Constitution, protecting specified individual liberties and reserving undelegated powers.

books_documents.name: The United States Constitution.zip
books_documents.summary: The foundational charter of the United States federal government, defining its branches, powers, limits, amendment process, and relationship to the states.

books_documents.name: The Writings of Thomas Paine.zip
books_documents.summary: A collection of Thomas Paine's political writings on independence, republican government, rights, revolution, religion, and social reform.

books_documents.name: Paradise Lost.zip
books_documents.summary: John Milton's epic poem about Satan's rebellion, the temptation of Adam and Eve, humanity's fall, and the possibility of redemption.

books_documents.name: The Aeneid by Virgil.zip
books_documents.summary: Virgil's Roman epic following the Trojan hero Aeneas through exile, war, duty, loss, and the legendary origins of Rome.

books_documents.name: The Iliad.zip
books_documents.summary: Homer's epic of the Trojan War centered on Achilles' anger, honor, grief, and conflict with Agamemnon near the war's end.

books_documents.name: The Odyssey.zip
books_documents.summary: Homer's epic of Odysseus' long voyage home from Troy, his encounters with danger and temptation, and his return to Ithaca.

books_documents.name: Adventures of Huckleberry Finn.zip
books_documents.summary: Mark Twain's novel following Huck Finn and Jim down the Mississippi, using their journey to examine freedom, conscience, friendship, and American racism.

books_documents.name: Moby-Dick.zip
books_documents.summary: Herman Melville's novel of Ishmael, Captain Ahab, and the Pequod's obsessive pursuit of a white whale, blending adventure with philosophical reflection.

books_documents.id: books_documents/the call of the wild by jack london.zip
books_documents.name: The call of the wild by Jack London.zip
books_documents.relativePath: books_documents/The call of the wild by Jack London.zip
books_documents.summary: Jack London's adventure novel about Buck, a domesticated dog forced into Yukon sled life who gradually answers the pull of the wild.

books_documents.name: The Great Gatsby.zip
books_documents.summary: F. Scott Fitzgerald's novel of Jay Gatsby's pursuit of Daisy Buchanan, seen through Nick Carraway amid wealth, longing, and disillusionment.

books_documents.name: The Jungle by Upton Sinclair.zip
books_documents.summary: Upton Sinclair's novel following an immigrant family through exploitation in Chicago's meatpacking industry and the harsh conditions of industrial labor.

books_documents.name: The Life of Frederick Douglass.zip
books_documents.summary: Frederick Douglass's autobiographical account of enslavement, literacy, resistance, escape, and his development as an abolitionist.

books_documents.id: books_documents/the works of edgar allan poe.zip
books_documents.name: The Works of Edgar Allan Poe.zip
books_documents.relativePath: books_documents/The Works of Edgar Allan Poe.zip
books_documents.summary: A collection of Edgar Allan Poe's poems, tales, and essays, ranging across Gothic horror, mystery, satire, grief, and psychological suspense.

books_documents.id: books_documents/walden, and on the duty of civil disobedience.zip
books_documents.name: Walden, and On The Duty Of Civil Disobedience.zip
books_documents.relativePath: books_documents/Walden, and On The Duty Of Civil Disobedience.zip
books_documents.summary: Henry David Thoreau's reflections on simple living at Walden Pond, paired with his argument for resisting government actions that violate conscience.

books_documents.name: White Fang by Jack London.zip
books_documents.summary: Jack London's novel tracing a wolf-dog's harsh life in the Yukon and his gradual transformation through human cruelty, survival, and kindness.

books_documents.name: Aesop’s fables.zip
books_documents.summary: A collection of brief animal tales traditionally attributed to Aesop, each using a simple story to convey a moral or practical lesson.

books_documents.name: Anna Karenina by Leo Tolstoy.zip
books_documents.summary: Tolstoy's novel interweaving Anna's tragic affair with Levin's search for meaning, examining family, society, love, work, and moral responsibility.

books_documents.name: Crime and Punishment, Dostoyevsky.zip
books_documents.summary: Dostoevsky's psychological novel about Raskolnikov, a poor student whose murder leads to guilt, investigation, moral conflict, and the possibility of redemption.

books_documents.id: books_documents/the complete works of william shakespeare.zip
books_documents.name: The Complete Works of William Shakespeare.zip
books_documents.relativePath: books_documents/The Complete Works of William Shakespeare.zip
books_documents.summary: A collected edition of Shakespeare's plays and poetry, including comedies, histories, tragedies, sonnets, and longer poems.

books_documents.name: The Count of Monte Cristo.zip
books_documents.summary: Alexandre Dumas's adventure novel about Edmond Dantès, whose wrongful imprisonment, escape, fortune, and elaborate revenge reshape many lives.

books_documents.id: books_documents/the mysterious island by jules verne.zip
books_documents.name: The Mysterious Island by Jules Verne.zip
books_documents.relativePath: books_documents/The Mysterious Island by Jules Verne.zip
books_documents.summary: Jules Verne's adventure novel about Civil War escapees using science and ingenuity to survive on an isolated island with a hidden mystery.

books_documents.name: Ulysses by James Joyce.zip
books_documents.summary: James Joyce's modernist novel following Leopold Bloom, Stephen Dedalus, and Molly Bloom through one day in Dublin using many shifting literary styles.

books_documents.name: Autobiography of Benjamin Franklin.zip
books_documents.summary: Benjamin Franklin's unfinished account of his early life, work, civic projects, habits of self-improvement, and rise in colonial America.

books_documents.id: books_documents/the art of war by sun tzu.zip
books_documents.name: The Art of War by Sun Tzu.zip
books_documents.relativePath: books_documents/The Art of War by Sun Tzu.zip
books_documents.summary: An ancient Chinese treatise on strategy, leadership, intelligence, preparation, deception, terrain, and winning conflicts efficiently.

books_documents.id: books_documents/the history of the decline and fall of the roman empire by edward gibbon.zip
books_documents.name: The History of the Decline and Fall of the Roman Empire by Edward Gibbon.zip
books_documents.relativePath: books_documents/The History of the Decline and Fall of the Roman Empire by Edward Gibbon.zip
books_documents.summary: Edward Gibbon's large historical work tracing the Roman Empire's decline from the second century through Byzantium and the fall of Constantinople.

books_documents.id: books_documents/how it works by archibald williams.zip
books_documents.name: How it Works by Archibald Williams.zip
books_documents.relativePath: books_documents/How it Works by Archibald Williams.zip
books_documents.summary: An illustrated early twentieth-century introduction to the mechanisms behind engines, electricity, transport, communications, tools, and everyday technologies.

books_documents.id: books_documents/on the origin of species by means of natural selection by charles darwin.zip
books_documents.name: On the Origin of Species By Means of Natural Selection by Charles Darwin.zip
books_documents.relativePath: books_documents/On the Origin of Species By Means of Natural Selection by Charles Darwin.zip
books_documents.summary: Charles Darwin's foundational argument that species change over generations through natural selection acting on heritable variation.

books_documents.id: books_documents/the age of invention - a chronicle of mechanical conquest.zip
books_documents.name: The Age of Invention - A Chronicle of Mechanical Conquest.zip
books_documents.relativePath: books_documents/The Age of Invention - A Chronicle of Mechanical Conquest.zip
books_documents.summary: A historical survey of American inventors and technologies that shaped industrial development, transportation, communication, manufacturing, and daily life.

books_documents.id: books_documents/the mechanical properties of wood by samuel j. record.zip
books_documents.name: The Mechanical Properties of Wood by Samuel J. Record.zip
books_documents.relativePath: books_documents/The Mechanical Properties of Wood by Samuel J. Record.zip
books_documents.summary: A technical reference on wood structure and mechanical behavior, including strength, elasticity, moisture, defects, testing, and factors affecting performance.

books_documents.id: books_documents/the wealth of nations by adam smith.zip
books_documents.name: The Wealth of Nations by Adam Smith.zip
books_documents.relativePath: books_documents/The Wealth of Nations by Adam Smith.zip
books_documents.summary: Adam Smith's study of production, trade, labor, markets, taxation, public institutions, and the forces he believed shape national prosperity.

books_documents.id: books_documents/anecdotes for boys by harvey newcomb.zip
books_documents.name: Anecdotes for boys by Harvey Newcomb.zip
books_documents.relativePath: books_documents/Anecdotes for boys by Harvey Newcomb.zip
books_documents.summary: A nineteenth-century collection of short moral anecdotes for boys, intended to illustrate character, habits, choices, and religious virtues.

books_documents.name: Boy Scouts Handbook (1911).zip
books_documents.summary: The early Boy Scouts of America handbook covering organization, citizenship, campcraft, knots, tracking, first aid, nature study, and outdoor skills of its era.

books_documents.name: Grimms' Fairy Tales.zip
books_documents.summary: A collection of traditional German folktales gathered by the Brothers Grimm, featuring magic, danger, cleverness, transformation, and moral consequences.

books_documents.name: Peter Pan.zip
books_documents.summary: J. M. Barrie's fantasy about Wendy, John, and Michael Darling joining Peter Pan in Neverland for adventures with the Lost Boys, fairies, and pirates.
